rows.what_the_ink_shows: Two small dark points stand to the right of L_0, the upper point slightly farther right. They are elevated relative to the baseline and the subscript 0. Comparable isolated dots are visible above L_0 and above the arrow. The pair is dark and close enough to resemble a small raised colon; the scan does not establish whether it is deliberate punctuation or accidental marks. Viewed full scan and enlarged contrast crop crops/134-2_scan149_Qsow072.jpg.
rows.note: The raised pair may be an authorial mark or incidental specks; the scan does not decide. Retain the existing \unsure{:} rather than silently remove it or introduce an empty-set symbol that is not in the manuscript. Here b records that the proposed omission would be editorial removal of a possible authorial mark, not a securely established reading correction. This classification does not assert that the pair is intentional punctuation.

events.type: used and rechecked in this run
events.outcome: Compared the raised conjectural colon with the enlarged pair of marks and nearby isolated dots. The optical evidence remains compatible with both punctuation and specks, so the row’s unqualified deletion was not accepted; an explicit colon/absence alternative is proposed.
